objectives.label: Protect the Heartgrove
objectives.directive: Its destruction ends this introductory mission in defeat.

objectives.label: Defeat the lone wolf
objectives.directive: Follow the southern path with Sentinels; keep the unarmed Wayfinder out of reach.

objectives.label: Clear the mountain den
objectives.directive: Cross the ridge south of the split summit, then follow the path south between the den teeth. Bring Sentinels together against the pack.

briefing.label: Circle of Repose · Cultivation
briefing.title: Restore the grove, Guide
briefing.description: Grow a base, gather Lifebloom, and train Sentinels. Defeat all six wolves to win.
briefing.goalsNote: One worker per site gives steady income. Move workers to the other site if a reserve runs low.
briefing.rules: 150 Lifebloom · Worker-tended growth · Renewable sites · Protect your Heartgrove

goals.label: Train a Cultivator
goals.directive: Select the Heartgrove, open Units, and train a Cultivator (50 Lifebloom).

goals.label: Grow a Lifebloom Conservatory
goals.directive: Select a Cultivator, open Buildings, and grow a Conservatory (100 Lifebloom).

goals.label: Grow a Musterhall
goals.directive: Gather Lifebloom, then use a Cultivator to grow a Musterhall (100 Lifebloom).

goals.label: Train Sentinels
goals.directive: Select the Musterhall to train Sentinels (35 Lifebloom). Wayfinders (20) scout but cannot fight.

popups.title: Welcome, Guide
popups.text: Select your Heartgrove, open Units, and train a Cultivator (50 Lifebloom). Then select the Cultivator and grow a Conservatory from Buildings (100 Lifebloom). Protect the Heartgrove while you build an army to clear the wolves.

popups.title: Tending growth
popups.text: Keep the Cultivator beside the building until it finishes growing. Moving or stopping the worker pauses growth. To resume, select a Cultivator and click the unfinished building. Your Heartgrove grows one building at a time.

popups.title: Cultivating Lifebloom
popups.text: Select the Cultivator, then click Near Lifebloom or choose Gather. It carries 30 Lifebloom to a Conservatory and repeats. One worker per site is sustainable. Extra workers drain the reserve; dormant sites recover automatically. Send workers to the other site to keep gathering.

popups.title: Gather your expedition
popups.text: Train Sentinels at the Musterhall to fight. Wayfinders scout farther but cannot attack. Select your Sentinels, choose Attack Move, and click a destination. Follow the southern path to the lone wolf, then cross the ridge to the den. Gift boxes along the route grant Lifebloom when a unit walks over them.
